feature_spec: Exactly v9 F2, 24 encoded columns from 14 raw fields. No new feature or room ID.
transforms: All use log1p(E) or log1p(E/q); float64 expm1 at inference, nonnegative bound, multiply q only for normalized models. No upper clipping or bias calibration.
weights: All training rows equal weight; no q sample weights in either model family.
selection: Per cell, GroupKFold(3) within outer fitting rooms. Minimum original-lux equal-room MAE; exact tie picks smaller XGB depth or larger Ridge lambda.
gate_references: Primary worst <= v9_C; >=5/7 rooms nonworse than v8_S1; orientation macro and worst <= v8_T1 and orientation LM608 <= v8_S1. Require all three primary absolute targets for full pass.
partial_progress: Separately report primary macro < v8_S1, BM432 <= v9_C, LM608 <= v8_S1; never call this attainment of 50/120/40.
promotion_order: Only full-pass candidates, lowest primary worst MAE then macro MAE then v10_X0/Xq/S0/Sq; no automatic deployment.
scope: Only seven TRAIN rooms. No TEST numeric conversion, fitting, tuning, prediction or scoring. No simulations, visualization, full-seven refit, room routing, calibration or other-output changes.
stopping_rule: Four cells, two parameters per cell, fixed grouped folds only. No extension after outer results. Keep old evidence and deployed trial immutable.
